gui_context: 拍卖创建与结算的完整说明
source_note: 原文、颜色与数值以本轮实测为准；社区 Wiki 普通页面核对机制。完整句在 GUI_Lore 匹配，不按旧英文断行翻译。

lines.raw: §7Click an item in your inventory to select it for this auction.
lines.text: Click an item in your inventory to select it for this auction.
lines.zh: 点击背包中的物品，将其选为本次拍卖的商品。

lines.raw: §7The price at which you want to sell this item.
lines.text: The price at which you want to sell this item.
lines.zh: 设置这件物品的出售价格。

lines.raw: §7How long the item will be up for sale.
lines.text: How long the item will be up for sale.

lines.raw: §7With traditional auctions, multiple buyers compete for the item by bidding turn by turn.
lines.text: With traditional auctions, multiple buyers compete for the item by bidding turn by turn.
lines.zh: 竞拍模式下，多名买家轮流出价，价高者得。

lines.raw: §7This item will be added to the auction house for other players to purchase.
lines.text: This item will be added to the auction house for other players to purchase.
lines.zh: 将此物品上架拍卖行，供其他玩家购买。

lines.raw: §7Set your own items on auction for other players to purchase.
lines.text: Set your own items on auction for other players to purchase.
lines.zh: 将自己的物品上架拍卖，供其他玩家购买。

lines.raw: §7Specify how long you want the auction to last.
lines.text: Specify how long you want the auction to last.
lines.zh: 自定义本次拍卖的持续时间。

lines.raw: §bAuctions in co-op are shared! Your coop partners can manage the auctions you create.
lines.text: Auctions in co-op are shared! Your coop partners can manage the auctions you create.
lines.zh: 合作成员共享拍卖! 你的合作伙伴也可以管理你创建的拍卖。

lines.context: 仅未收到出价的拍卖可以取消
lines.raw: §7You may cancel auctions as long as they have §c0 §7bids!
lines.text: You may cancel auctions as long as they have 0 bids!
lines.zh: 拍卖尚未收到出价（0 次）时，可以取消!
